preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_form_palindrome(s) else ' '.join(map(str, P))
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to form a palindrome, output -1; otherwise, output the permutation P that results in a palindrome.
The length of the permutation P must be equal to the length of the string s.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= len(s) for p in P)
postconditions.description: Each element in the permutation P must be a valid index within the range of the string s.
